playwrightModule: playwright (local module supplied to the original functional check)
scope: Eight sequential real dedicated-worker OPFS/IndexedDB cases with a 256 KiB synthetic parameter. Exact pinned-SHA roundtrip, simulated policy pressure, explicit logical quota and I/O/cancellation injections, owned session and backing cleanup. External process load is not measured; no isolated performance claim.
